tools.name: plan_build
tools.description: Covers cut lists, planter plans and material quantities for paint, tile, soil or concrete. Saves a buy list and drawings with positions. Defaults: common US stock and 1/8-inch kerf. 25 saved plans daily.

tools.name: plan_recipe
tools.description: Covers recipe or weekly meal nutrition, allergens and shopping. 25 saved plans daily. For recalls alone, use Recalls. Check labels for allergens. Not a statement that a meal is healthy. Not medical or diet advice.

tools.name: check_trip
tools.description: Covers destination advice, weather, health notices, holidays, exchange rates, recent fares and US airport delays. Fares are cached finds and booking links may be paid. Divux does not book flights. Advisories are not a destination safety assessment.

tools.name: check_car
tools.description: Covers US vehicle recalls, complaints, ratings and fuel economy by VIN or model year. Miles give fuel cost. VIN, odometer and US ZIP give estimated value. Canadian recall link included. For a recall-only question, see Recalls. This is not a safety assessment.

tools.name: check_food
tools.description: Applies to nutrition, ingredients, allergens and meal totals from names or barcodes. Includes possible recalls for named brands. For a recall-only question, see Recalls. Figures are not a safety assessment. Not medical or diet advice.

tools.name: check_cosmetic
tools.description: Covers EU bans and limits on skin, hair and makeup ingredients, plus fragrance allergens and brand recalls. Send an ingredient list, product name or barcode. For a medicine or food, use Medicine or Food.

tools.name: check_pet
tools.description: Covers US pet food and treat recalls and poison-control entries for foods or plants that a dog or cat may eat. For other products and human food, see Recalls. Not a safety assessment or veterinary advice.

tools.name: check_kitchen
tools.description: Covers cooking temperatures, storage, pan swaps, baking and brines. Includes ham, bison, goat, rabbit, venison and shellfish. Distinguishes trade practice from the federal 156 ppm curing limit. Not a safety assessment or medical advice.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Applies to reporting a wrong figure, broken or missing tool, or idea. Stores a short report for Divux. Whitespace and control characters are cleaned up, and detected sensitive values are removed. Up to 5 reports a day per connection.

tools.name: check_place
tools.description: Covers area-center flood, water, air, crime, childcare or weather for a city worldwide or US ZIP. Coverage varies by country. Optional details include schools, colleges, US parks and the night sky. These are public records, not a safety assessment or insurance quote.

tools.name: check_medicine
tools.description: Covers a medicine's uses, warnings, recalls and shortages by brand or generic name. The US label can be checked for mentions of a second medicine, food, alcohol or pregnancy. Choose Canada or an EU country for local records. For device or recall-only searches, use Recalls.

tools.name: check_care
tools.description: Covers US clinicians by exact NPI, name or specialty, hospital and nursing home ratings, and recruiting clinical trials by condition and location. Clinician records give credentials and practice details. The registry does not rate clinicians or confirm insurance coverage.

tools.name: check_company
tools.description: Covers company registration and active status in selected registers, US consumer-finance complaints, and public filings. Search by legal name or US ticker and optionally compare a second company. Customer reviews, stock prices and scam reports aren't included.

tools.name: check_fitness
tools.description: Covers exercises by muscle and equipment, workouts with sets, reps, rest and RPE, and estimated recovery from hard sets. Also guidance, calories, heart-rate zones, steps and trails. Workout and recovery: age 13+. Not medical advice or a readiness assessment.

tools.name: check_illness
tools.description: Covers what's going around: US COVID, flu and RSV levels nationally or by state, with optional county wastewater details. For other countries, find outbreak reports, travel health notices and local public health resources. Use Trip for a full destination check.

tools.name: check_money
tools.description: Applies to pay by job and location, buying power between years, central-bank rates, US Treasury yields or currency exchange. US cash examples can include national savings and CD averages. Mortgage rates are outside its coverage. Not investment advice.

tools.name: check_recalls
tools.description: Covers official recalls for products, food, medicines, devices and vehicles by name, VIN, year/make/model or items list. Kids covers child gear. For pet food, see Pets. US, UK, Canada and EU coverage varies. An empty result does not prove safety. Not medical advice.

tools.name: check_chemistry
tools.description: Applies to element and compound lookups, molar mass, equation balancing, solution math, physical constants and unit conversion. A question can infer the kind, for example 'molar mass of caffeine' or 'convert 5 km to miles'.

tools.name: learn_piano
tools.description: Applies to piano chords, scales, fingering, keyboard ranges and practice plans. Shows the notes on a keyboard and links to Divux Piano for practice. A practice goal can be a phrase such as 'play pop songs'.

tools.name: find_product
tools.description: Covers product search and prices at US stores by name, model, barcode or product_id. Appliance categories cover efficiency in the US, Australia and New Zealand. Prices exclude tax. Links may be paid. Divux does not check out.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_care" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.divux.si" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_company · Private data: check_place, check_medicine, check_care · Public sink: check_cosmetic, send_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_company · Private data: check_place, check_medicine, check_care · Public sink: check_cosmetic, send_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "plan_build" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Applies to cut lists, planter plans and material amounts for paint, tile, soil or concrete. Divux saves a buy list and drawings when positions are supplied. Uses common US stock sizes and a 1/8-inch saw kerf unless specified. Up to 25 saved plans a day." → after: "Covers cut lists, planter plans and material quantities for paint, tile, soil or concrete. Saves a buy list and drawings with positions. Defaults: common US stock and 1/8-inch kerf. 25 saved plans daily."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
